free_tier.stated: No free tier since 2024-03-31. Current public page offers only a 30-day free trial; Standard plan $7/TB storage + $7/TB egress with a $5/month minimum.
free_tier.notes: no standing free allowance; the trial's 25GB of upload and download for 30 days is the only free volume

egress.terms: 'Egress $7/TB' on the Standard tier — metered, and the previous '1x free egress allowance' was explicitly removed: 'The previous 1x free egress allowance for Regional Workflows (now Advanced) has been replaced with a simplified, lower per-TB egress rate across both tiers.'

tooling: S3-compatible gateway, Uplink CLI, rclone s3 backend; Object Mount (FUSE) with 2 free licenses per account.
chaining: none — $7/TB storage and $7/TB egress with a hard $5/month floor. Serving 500 GB/day is ~15 TB/month = ~$105/month of egress alone.
limits_note: $5/month minimum invoice that 'is not a usage credit'; free trial excluded from the minimum; accounts at $0 balance with no storage are suspended after a grace period.

identity_cost.detail: sign-up asks for an email address and a password, with no card; Pro account limits follow a payment method: a credit card (some debit cards; prepaid cards are not supported), Google Pay, Apple Pay, a bank account, or a deposit of USD 10 or more in USDC on Ethereum mainnet

reliability_note: The Free Tier was discontinued in 2024: users had until March 31 to upgrade to a Pro Account, and Free Tier data was removed from the network; the 25GB offered now is a free trial, not a standing tier

evidence.proved: (2024-02-26) — 'Storj is discontinuing the "Free Tier"... Current users of the Free Tier have from now until March 31 to upgrade'
Free trial 'Free for 30 days'; Standard 'Monthly storage $7/TB', 'Egress $7/TB'; 'Minimum monthly fee ... is $5'
'The previous 1x free egress allowance ... has been replaced'
the sign-up form asks for an email address and a password and states that no credit card is needed
evidence.quote: No credit card needed to create an account.

evidence.proved: Pro limits follow a payment method, and a USDC deposit of $10 or more upgrades an account without a card
evidence.quote: Adding $10 or more in USDC to your account deposit address will automatically upgrade your account to PRO.

evidence.proved: the vendor's announcement of 2024-02-26 ended the Free Tier, with March 31 as the last day to upgrade to a Pro Account
evidence.quote: Current users of the Free Tier have from now until March 31 to upgrade to a Pro Account to continue using Storj.

evidence.proved: Free Tier data was removed from the network after the Free Tier ended
evidence.quote: Storj will be removing the Free Tier data from the network (as well as some test data) at a pace roughly aligned with the increase in paid data.

evidence.proved: the trial allows 25GB of upload and download for 30 days
evidence.quote: Upload and download 25GB free for 30 days.

evidence.proved: the Standard plan prices storage at $7/TB per month and egress at $7/TB

notes: No free tier since 2024-03-31. Current public page offers only a 30-day free trial; Standard plan $7/TB storage + $7/TB egress with a $5/month minimum.
